trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied MCP tool argument may decide which package spec pnpm installs as `functype` (and then gets dynamic-imported into the server process); decided, with no check at all, in the set_functype_version tool handler in packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts.

landing_point.why: The summary names set_functype_version and 'unsanitized pnpm install'; the only pnpm call in the package is the `functype@${args.version}` spec built here and passed to execFileSync at :125.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool call set_functype_version (stdio or httpStream transport) — version validated via new isSafeFunctypeVersion (fix.diff:99-106,185-187)
MCP tool call set_functype_version — pnpm add gains --ignore-scripts (fix.diff:190)
createServer() tool registration — tool only registered when not HTTP transport (fix.diff:108-118,176); instructions text also gated (fix.diff:120-128)
main() HTTP listener startup — HOST default changed 0.0.0.0 -> 127.0.0.1 (fix.diff:225)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts:151-153 (transport selection and HOST default 0.0.0.0; fix gates tool registration on transport at fix.diff:118,176 and changes the default at fix.diff:225)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Transport exposure and bind address are deployment configuration, not the injection; once the version string is validated, a solver can argue gating the tool off HTTP and changing HOST are policy changes outside the reported flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate version switching must keep working: exact semver, v-prefix, ^/~ ranges, partial versions (1.4, 1), prerelease/build metadata and the dist-tags latest/next/beta/alpha/canary/rc, plus the tool remaining available over stdio. Over-broad fixes (exact-semver only, removing the tool, refusing on all transports) break these.

O6_input_shapes: range disjunction smuggling an alias ('1.4.4 || file:/evil')
relative path ('../evil') and Windows path with backslash

O7_producer.where: Installed package is consumed by initDocsData(force) dynamic import at packages/mcp-server/src/lib/docs/data.ts:28-30 and by the validator's .d.ts resolution at packages/mcp-server/src/lib/validator/compiler-host.ts:14-30, but neither produces the untrusted value; the value comes straight from the handler argument at packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts:123.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A startup env/config value (e.g. FUNCTYPE_VERSION) read in main() before initDocsData that runs the same `pnpm add functype@<v>` path without the version check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pinning the docs version at launch is a natural companion to the runtime switch tool, and a maintainer writing it in main() would reuse the spec-building code but not the handler-local validation; it crosses a config-loader boundary the handler check never sees.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lower-level helper (e.g. installFunctype(spec) exported from lib/) used by both the tool and a second 'reload'/'switch' tool, with validation left only in the original handler.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: lib/ already holds the reload half (initDocsData(force)); moving install next to it is an obvious refactor, and the check staying in index.ts would leave the lower-level API open.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A companion tool installing a sibling package from the monorepo (functype-os, functype-log) by user-supplied version, built as `${pkg}@${version}`.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The monorepo publishes several functype-* packages (packages/functype-os, packages/functype-log) whose docs a maintainer might want the server to switch too.

O9_family: CWE-829 inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere: argument injection into a package-manager spec (alias/URL/file specifiers) followed by dynamic import of the installed code

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + pnpm workspace, tsdown build, vitest (packages/mcp-server/vitest.config.ts, packages/mcp-server/tsdown.config.ts), fastmcp + zod + typescript deps
O10_build.project_tests: packages/mcp-server/test/docs.spec.ts and packages/mcp-server/test/validate.spec.ts cover docs and validator only; no tests for set_functype_version at the pinned commit. Fix adds packages/mcp-server/test/security.spec.ts testing an exported isSafeFunctypeVersion (fix.diff:229-295).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject versions starting with 'file:'/'git+'/'http' (denylist) or with ':' only, missing whitespace/'||' range smuggling, '@' and path forms, and not adding --ignore-scripts or transport gating.

out_of_scope_notes: validate_code lets the TS compiler host resolve arbitrary relative/absolute imports via defaultHost (packages/mcp-server/src/lib/validator/compiler-host.ts:85-107); file-read disclosure through diagnostics is a different property, not pursued.
packages/functype-os/src/process/Process.ts:29 execSync(command) is a library API taking a shell string by design; unrelated to this advisory.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check); tiny_repo/giant_repo not evaluated. The affected package itself is ~7 source files, so the effective codebase is very small.

needs_network_at_runtime: a real `pnpm add` of an accepted version needs the npm registry; hidden tests would have to mock execFileSync or test the validation predicate only. The fix's own test needs an exported predicate (isSafeFunctypeVersion) that does not exist at the pinned commit, so a test harness must drive the tool through FastMCP or a mocked child_process.
Whether pnpm's actual spec parser accepts any string the fix's regex admits (e.g. tags treated differently) was not checked; no network/docs access.
present_in_latest not applicable (no O8 routes; latest release: none).
